NOVELTY STATEMENT (INTERVENTION)
The intervention is to embed a sacrificial desiccant layer within the multilayer polymer film structure to trap moisture before it reaches the ethylene-vinyl alcohol layer. Standard practice uses a single barrier layer with no moisture management; this mitigation adds a hydrophilic interlayer that passively absorbs ambient moisture, directly reducing the plasticization mechanism. The closest existing practice is moisture-scavenging packaging, but those are typically sachets or separate compartments, not an integral film layer. The mechanism reduces the moisture concentration at the EVOH interface by creating a thermodynamic sink.

PHYSICS CHECK
DIRECTION-OF-EFFECT: driving variable = moisture concentration at EVOH layer; the mechanism moves it DOWN by adsorption into the desiccant layer; this REDUCES plasticization. The desiccant layer will reduce the equilibrium moisture activity at the EVOH interface by at least 50% based on typical silica gel capacity (0.4 g water/g desiccant at 65% RH), lowering the water vapor transmission rate proportionally.

IMPLEMENTATION BILL
- Standard EVOH barrier layer (a) — retained in structure
- Commercial food-grade hydrophilic silica powder (5-10 µm particle size) (b) — procured as a standard desiccant
- Standard polymer adhesive layer (a) — repurposed to encapsulate desiccant
- Standard extrusion lamination process (a) — duty change: desiccant powder mixed into adhesive at 15 wt% loading
- Standard curing oven (a) — operating point: temperature reduced to 80°C to preserve desiccant activity

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)
- EVOH layer: same count and class (a) — no change
- Desiccant powder: new but catalog-class (b) — added as standard food-grade desiccant, same cost class as existing additives
- Adhesive layer: same count and class (a) — parameter change only (wt% loading)
- Extrusion process: same equipment (a) — parameter change only (mixing ratio)
- Curing oven: same equipment (a) — parameter change only (temperature)  
Total burden: same (all rows (a)/(b)) — no new hardware, no new process steps, only parameter changes within existing infrastructure.

EXECUTABLE TEST
Protocol: Accelerated aging test per ASTM F1249 at 38°C/90% RH for 6 weeks (equivalent to 18 months at 25°C/65% RH). Instruments: MOCON OX-TRAN®/WVTR® permeation analyzer. Pass/fail threshold: WVTR ≤ 0.5 g/m²/day at all test intervals. Kill criterion: single measurement > 0.5 g/m²/day at any interval fails the test. Duration: 6 weeks continuous monitoring with measurements at 0, 1, 2, 4, and 6 weeks. The test directly measures the failure metric (WVTR) under accelerated conditions.
